inferences: The target fundingTime values align with the scheduled 00:00, 08:00, and 16:00 UTC funding slots, so fundingTime is reasonably interpreted as the funding event/settlement slot, not as an endpoint publication timestamp. This is not a retained target-effective Binance definition.

Because the support formula uses Mark Price and the target REST rows contain markPrice, the row field may be associated with funding calculation. No retained target-effective first-party passage proves byte-for-byte that it is the exact mark used for each settled charge.

A rate can be applied/exchanged at a scheduled funding time without the exact REST history row being published to participants at that same instant. Application and API publication are separate facts.
